metadata.title: TRAITÉ DE LA FABRICATION DU SUCRE
metadata.title_complement: Comprenant la culture des plantes saccharines, l'extraction du sucre brut, le raffinage, le traitement des mélasses, la distillation et les opérations relatives au travail des salins et potasses, l'analyse des matières utiles à la culture et à la fabrication, etc., etc.

typographie_suggestion.explanation: The typeface features the high contrast between thick and thin strokes, vertical stress, and small, unbracketed (hairline) serifs characteristic of the "Modern" or Didone style popular in 19th-century academic and formal publishing.
